texts.en:
The inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have enhanced their agricultural skills through experimentation with nutrient-rich fertilizers. Their harvests are yielding higher quality produce and the health of their society is improving.

Given their rudimentary technology, this advancement in food production is remarkable. Obtaining a sample of the fertilizer should allow us to replicate the achievement on a wider scale.

summary.text:
# 温顺好生养 / Tractable and Fertile

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:1113-1304`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 100。“挣脱桎梏”帝国观测原母族时使用的专用事件池中也有本事件。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 100. It is also in the separate pool used when a Broken Shackles empire observes its parent civilization.
- 条件：拥有“首次接触”DLC；该文明处于石器时代且被“被动观察”任务观测（或有游牧中继站观察者）；每个前超光速文明一次。
  Conditions: First Contact DLC; the civilization is in the Stone Age and observed with a Passive Observation mission (or by a nomad waystation); once per pre-FTL civilization.
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1256「温顺好生养」：原始居民改良了肥料，收成大增。
  1256 "Tractable and Fertile": the natives improved their fertilizers and harvests.
- 选“继续远距离监测”：获得洞见与社会学研究。选“派队取样”：获得洞见与 50 食物，但构成违反不干涉议案的干涉；360 天后 1257「已研究样品」，获得 360 天的食物（岩石生命则矿物）丰收修正。
  Keep monitoring: insight and society research. Obtain a sample: insight and 50 food, but it counts as a breach of the non-interference resolution; 360 days later 1257 "Samples Studied" grants a 360-day food (or, for lithoids, rock) abundance modifier.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 两个选项互斥；只有取样会引出 1257。
  The two options are exclusive; only sampling leads to 1257.
- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无额外的文明差异分支。
  No further empire-specific variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：1255 触发、1256/1257 文本与效果、360 天延迟、观测事件锁定/解锁。
  Checked: 1255 trigger, 1256/1257 text and effects, 360-day delay, observation-event lock/unlock.
